sub_graphs.title: Cancun Stack Instructions: PUSH Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models the PUSH0 through PUSH32 opcodes that read bytecode and push values onto the EVM stack

nodes.label: Program Counter at PUSH Opcode
nodes.description: EVM program counter points to a PUSHn instruction in bytecode

nodes.label: Charge PUSH Gas
nodes.description: Deduct gas for PUSH operation - GAS_BASE for PUSH0, GAS_VERY_LOW for PUSH1-32

nodes.label: Read N Immediate Bytes from Bytecode
nodes.description: Read N bytes following the opcode from code buffer where N is 0-32

nodes.label: Convert Bytes to U256
nodes.description: Interpret the read bytes as big-endian U256 value

nodes.label: Push Value to Stack
nodes.description: Push the U256 value onto the top of the EVM stack

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Advance PC by 1 plus number of bytes read (1 for PUSH0, 1+N for PUSHn)

nodes.label: Pushed Value on Stack Top
nodes.description: Stack now contains the pushed value at position 0

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Stack Instructions: POP Operation
sub_graphs.description: Models the POP opcode that removes the top item from the EVM stack

nodes.label: Stack Has Items
nodes.description: EVM stack contains at least one item that can be popped

nodes.label: Charge POP Gas
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_BASE from available gas for POP operation

nodes.label: Remove Top Stack Item
nodes.description: Remove and discard the value at the top of the stack

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Advance PC by 1 to next instruction

nodes.label: Stack Item Removed
nodes.description: Stack height decreased by one, previous second item is now top

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Stack Instructions: DUP Operations with Underflow Check
sub_graphs.description: Models DUP1-DUP16 opcodes that duplicate stack items with stack underflow validation

nodes.label: DUP Instruction Initiated
nodes.description: EVM encounters DUPn instruction where n specifies which item to duplicate

nodes.label: Charge DUP Gas
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_VERY_LOW from available gas

nodes.label: Check Stack Has N Items
nodes.description: Verify that stack has at least item_number items (0-indexed, so DUP1 needs 1 item)

nodes.label: Stack Depth Sufficient
nodes.description: Stack has enough items to perform the DUP operation

nodes.label: Stack Underflow Detected
nodes.description: Stack does not have enough items - item_number >= len(stack)

nodes.label: Raise StackUnderflowError
nodes.description: Raise StackUnderflowError exception, causing execution to halt

nodes.label: Read Nth Stack Item
nodes.description: Read value at position item_number from top of stack (0-indexed)

nodes.label: Push Duplicate to Stack Top
nodes.description: Push copy of the read value onto the stack top

nodes.label: Duplicate on Stack
nodes.description: Stack now contains duplicate value at top, original remains in place

nodes.label: Execution Halted - Stack Underflow
nodes.description: EVM execution terminated due to stack underflow error

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Stack Instructions: SWAP Operations with Underflow Check
sub_graphs.description: Models SWAP1-SWAP16 opcodes that exchange stack positions with stack underflow validation

nodes.label: SWAP Instruction Initiated
nodes.description: EVM encounters SWAPn instruction where n specifies which item to swap with top

nodes.label: Charge SWAP Gas
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_VERY_LOW from available gas

nodes.label: Check Stack Has N+1 Items
nodes.description: Verify stack has items at position 0 and position item_number

nodes.label: Stack Depth OK for SWAP
nodes.description: Stack has enough items to perform the SWAP operation

nodes.label: Stack Underflow for SWAP
nodes.description: Stack does not have item at position item_number

nodes.label: Raise StackUnderflowError
nodes.description: Raise StackUnderflowError for insufficient stack depth

nodes.label: Exchange Stack Values
nodes.description: Swap value at position 0 with value at position item_number

nodes.label: Values Swapped
nodes.description: Stack positions 0 and item_number now contain each other's original values

nodes.label: Execution Halted - SWAP Underflow
nodes.description: EVM execution terminated due to stack underflow in SWAP

ambiguities.text: The behavior of SWAP when item_number equals zero is described as 'no-op' but it's unclear if gas is still charged
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume gas is charged regardless of whether a meaningful swap occurs. This follows the pattern that gas is charged before the operation logic.

ambiguities.text: Stack overflow conditions are not explicitly mentioned for PUSH and DUP operations
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the EVM has a maximum stack depth of 1024 items and operations that would exceed this raise StackOverflowError. This should be verified against EVM specification.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EVM stack implementation correctly maintains ordering where position 0 is always the top
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DUP and SWAP operations would access wrong stack positions, corrupting computation

implicit_assumptions.description: Bytecode read during PUSH operations cannot be modified during execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If code could be modified mid-execution, PUSH could read unexpected values, enabling code injection attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: Gas costs for stack operations are calibrated to prevent resource exhaustion attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced stack operations could enable denial of service through rapid stack manipulation
